title: Freelance Invoice Template
subtitle: A professional invoice pre-filled for freelance work — hourly or project fees, revisions and usage licenses. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Net 14 — payment due within 14 days. Late fee of 1.5% per month applies after the due date.
notes: Thank you for your business. Usage rights transfer upon full payment.
features: Auto-calculating tax formulas in Excel (just enter your state rate)
Pre-filled freelance line items: hourly or project fee, revisions, usage license, expenses
License / usage fee line for creative work (stock photos, fonts, deliverables)
Clean one-page layout that makes you look established

faqs.q: What should I include on a freelance invoice?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name and EIN where required, the client and project details, a dated line-item list of work (hourly or project fee, revisions, expenses), tax, and a total due. Add a license / usage fee line if the work grants usage rights to deliverables.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate tax automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, tax and total update automatically. Leave the tax rate blank if you are not required to charge sales tax.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with a CPA or attorney before use.
